t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The color red seems to bring better luck then the other colors so that is the one to look  out for.

vb_textbox.text: At the start my advice said it seems completely random and that the red with red baskets do the best. That is not what I noticed. I noticed it was very random at time the blue always had higher mushrooms but in the next round it could seem like it was the yellow. Just use your own judgement and good luck!
